questions.question: What deceptive words did the people trust in Jeremiah 7's temple sermon?
options: 'Our sacrifices have made us clean' declared by the priests
'This is the temple of the LORD' repeated three times
'We are the children of Abraham' said with pride
'The LORD will never let Zion fall' spoken boldly
questions.answer: 'This is the temple of the LORD' repeated three times

questions.question: What had God's house become, according to Jeremiah 7?
options: A grand palace for the king
A true house of prayer for all
A den of robbers in their eyes
questions.answer: A den of robbers in their eyes

questions.question: Jeremiah 7 tells the people to amend their ways and deeds if they want to dwell in the land.
Has this house, which is called by my name, become a den of _____ in your eyes?
Do not trust in these deceptive words: 'This is the _____ of the LORD.'
